cards.mood: The piece opens with a tender, narrative ballad atmosphere that quickly fractures into a tense, confrontational dialogue.
cards.palette: A grand piano anchors the introduction with delicate arpeggios, later replaced by distorted electric guitars playing heavy power chords that drive the rock sections.

[Intro]
[Verse]
He held the crown in trembling hands
She stood before him, ground in sands
A kingdom built on whispered lies
Reflected in their searching eyes
